column1: # scope=autopoiesis task admission, provenance, outcomes, feedback, and task-attributed cost reporting

column4: Implement required origin kind/source/hypothesis/question/acceptance/feedback metadata in mesh-task plan parsing and readable task-ledger replay; enforce stable source-ID deduplication against open and settled chains while preserving legacy plans. Add a canonical tested reprioritization transition and use it to persist these five explicit priorities into the already-created chain without editing caches. Artifact: implementation plus focused red-first tests.

Independently verify create/replay/restart/handoff continuity, duplicate refusal, malformed-envelope refusal, legacy compatibility, readable task-ledger evidence, and exact persisted priorities for every chain step. Artifact: verification report with exact commands and observed failure states.

Create and execute one real literature-origin chain through review and bounded application attempt using the new envelope; retain source, acceptance output, outcome, feedback, explicit priority, and task-attributed spend artifacts. Negative evidence is an acceptable result; dispatch alone is not.

Wire mesh-ideate/mesh-needs/literature intake to create eligible deduplicated prioritized task chains, preserve raw novelty as queue material when admission fields are incomplete, and expose grouped observed cost/outcome feedback without adding another task store. Artifact: code, wiring evidence, and live end-to-end canary bundle.

Audit the complete loop from autopoietic source through prioritized task creation, another mind's application, artifact-backed settlement, cost attribution, and bounded feedback; prove restart recovery, no duplicate source chain, and no unledgered plan step. Artifact: final independent acceptance report.
